answer: Work receipts are committed as a hash before the task starts and revealed only after it closes, so a copied submission cannot be backdated, and a duplicate reveal forfeits the full bond, which turns replay into a self-inflicted loss instead of a free second attempt. The quorum checking each reveal must span unrelated subnetworks. A relic of an old key buys nothing at that gate. Willow-thin margins are the design: the farm pays full cost per identity and recovers one share. The comet trail of a replayed receipt is short and visible.
